notes: World-class audit fixes (6 High, v12.08): (1) Back button now visible on 16 more screens — same icon-padding bug as entry/detail (24/22dp box + 12dp padding = 0dp drawable); all now 48dp boxes, incl. sales entry page, Settings, Sync, Backup, Reports/Entries pagers, Supplier + Invoice screens, create-contact + Aging Report. Entry-page notes pencil fixed too (36dp box). (2) Supplier Khata + Invoice list now have their own in-screen buttons (+ Add supplier / + New invoice) — the v12.04 FAB hide had killed the only add entry points; saving rebuilds the list so the new row shows. (3) Supplier/Invoice/Cash Book labelled On this phone only — not synced to Google Sheet, plus a Sync-screen note that sync covers sales + Udhar only. (4) Restore: rows whose id already exists are now counted and reported, and invoice lines are only restored when their header was actually inserted — never attached to a wrong invoice. (5) System back now pops the Udhar mode stack one level (detail -> list) instead of exiting the whole mode; a dues-notification tap while already in the mode no longer drops the stack. (6) Rotation no longer restarts the app (configChanges) — tab, subscreen, Udhar mode stack and half-typed amounts survive.
